description: Score a comment for toxicity (Perspective-compatible). $0.005 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/toxicity/analyze.

clientToken.description: string - optional, echoed back in the response

comment.description: object (required) - {text: string} comment to score, Perspective comments:analyze body

doNotStore.description: boolean - optional; comment text is never stored regardless

languages.description: array of strings - optional; en = full attributes, fr/es/it/pt/tr/ru = TOXICITY-only

requestedAttributes.description: object (required) - attribute configs for TOXICITY, SEVERE_TOXICITY, IDENTITY_ATTACK, INSULT, THREAT, PROFANITY (FLIRTATION unsupported)

name: toxicity_analyze
